svg.title: Action-conditioned visual JEPA architecture
svg.desc: A left-to-right diagram shows rendered frame pairs entering a visual encoder, then an action-conditioned predictor, a predicted latent, a frozen state readout, a planner, and environment feedback. The environment sends new rendered frames back to the encoder. The action enters the predictor.
